history.summary: IMPORTANT IDENTITY NOTE: this is the local Omkareshwar Shiva temple at Vardhaman Nagar in Jalgaon city (near DSP Chowk / RTO Chowk / M.J. College), NOT the famous Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga on the Narmada island in Khandwa district, Madhya Pradesh. Several tourism pages (incredibleindia.gov.in, MakeMyTrip) list an 'Omkareshwar Temple' under Jalgaon while describing the MP Jyotirlinga legend (Vindhya, Narmada) — that conflation is documented here for clarity. This Jalgaon temple is a popular city shrine with a lingam deity, rated 4.6/5 from ~1,600 reviews, drawing crowds in Shravan and at Mahashivratri. There is also a separate 'Omkareshwar Temple Jalgaon' listing at Ramdas Colony; whether the two are distinct temples is unverified. No founding-date information was found online.

name: Omkareshwar Temple
town_description: Jalgaon is a major city in northern Maharashtra in the Khandesh region, famous for its banana crop, gold trade, cotton and industries. It is the headquarters of Jalgaon district and a rail and road hub connecting central Maharashtra, with well-known regional pilgrim spots such as Padmalaya and the Manudevi temple nearby. The city sits on the Tapi river plain with the Satpura ranges to the north.
